title: Immutable Collections
description: Build persistent immutable List and Map collections with structural sharing for efficiency.

steps.title: Implement immutable Vector (List)
steps.description: Build a persistent Vector class backed by a balanced tree. Implement `.push(value)`, `.pop()`, `.get(index)`, and `.set(index, value)` — all returning new Vectors without mutating the original. Print both the old and new versions to show they differ.
hints: Use a fixed branching factor (e.g., 32) to store values in tree nodes
get() traverses the tree by computing the index path at each level
push() and set() use path copying: clone nodes along the path to the leaf

verification.successMessage: Vector push and pop return new versions while preserving old ones
verification.failureMessage: Vector mutation mutated the original or did not return distinct versions

steps.title: Add structural sharing
steps.description: Ensure that when a new Vector is created via push/set, unchanged nodes are shared between the old and new versions. Print the number of shared nodes to demonstrate that only the path to the changed leaf is copied.
hints: Path copying automatically creates structural sharing — only nodes on the path to the target index are new
Compare node references between versions to identify shared nodes
A Vector with branching factor 32 needs at most log_32(n) new nodes per update

verification.successMessage: Structural sharing preserves most nodes between versions
verification.failureMessage: No structural sharing detected — all nodes may be copied

steps.title: Implement persistent Map
steps.description: Build a persistent Map using a Hash Array Mapped Trie (HAMT). Implement `.get(key)`, `.set(key, value)`, and `.delete(key)` — each returning a new Map. Use the key's hash code to determine the tree path. Print the size and values after mutations.
hints: Hash the key and use 5-bit chunks of the hash to index into child nodes at each level
Use a bitmap index to compress sparse nodes: 32 bits indicate which slots are occupied
On collision, replace a leaf entry with a sub-trie node

verification.successMessage: Persistent Map correctly stores and retrieves key-value pairs
verification.failureMessage: Map could not store or retrieve values via the HAMT structure

steps.title: Add mutating convenience methods
steps.description: Implement `.set(key, value)`, `.update(key, updater)`, `.remove(key)`, `.merge(other)` on Map and `.push(value)`, `.pop()`, `.splice(start, count, ...items)` on Vector. All methods return new instances. Print before and after states.
hints: update(key, fn) is get + set: const old = get(key); return set(key, fn(old))
merge(other) iterates other's entries and calls set for each
splice requires splitting the tree, removing a range, and inserting new items

verification.successMessage: Mutating convenience methods return correct new instances
verification.failureMessage: Convenience methods did not produce expected before and after states

steps.title: Implement merge and equals
steps.description: Implement `.merge(...collections)` that deep-merges Maps and `.equals(other)` that performs deep value equality on both Map and Vector. Merge should recursively combine nested Maps. Print whether two structures are equal.
hints: merge recursively calls itself when both sides have a Map at the same key
equals traverses both structures in parallel, comparing primitive values with Object.is
For Arrays/Vectors, compare element-by-element in index order

verification.successMessage: Deep merge and equality check work correctly
verification.failureMessage: Equality check returned wrong result or merge did not combine deeply

steps.title: Add conversion to/from plain objects
steps.description: Implement `.toJS()` on both Map and Vector that converts to plain JS objects/arrays, and a static `fromJS(value)` factory that recursively converts plain objects to persistent Map and arrays to persistent Vector. Print the round-trip result.
hints: toJS() recursively converts: Map entries become { key: toJS(value) }, Vector becomes [...]
fromJS() checks if value is a plain Object (Map) or Array (Vector) and recurses
Handle primitive values as-is — they don't need conversion

verification.successMessage: Conversion to and from plain objects round-trips correctly
verification.failureMessage: toJS or fromJS did not produce the expected converted structure
